sourceHashMethod: SHA-256 of decompressed physical lines before cutoff, LF-terminated; malformed lines included; source records at/after cutoff excluded

timing.description: Tool-ID time is an undocumented ordering inference, checked against task bounds, not an original timestamp. Record time is reliable only in root log.
